quarterly_data.quarter: Foxconn Industrial Internet annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 revenue RMB 902,887,188 thousand, up 48.22% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 35,285,561 thousand, up 51.99%. Q4 2025 revenue RMB 298,955,758 thousand and net profit RMB 12,798,793 thousand. The company attributes revenue growth to the continued expansion of the AI server market, steadily rising share at its main customers and strong cloud-service-provider business. Operating cash flow fell 78.01% to RMB 5,237,909 thousand as it built inventory on strong AI server demand; inventory rose 76.99% to RMB 150,912,711 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: Revenue RMB 902,887,188 thousand (+48.22%); net profit RMB 35,285,561 thousand (+51.99%); Q4 revenue RMB 298,955,758 thousand

quarterly_data.quarter: Foxconn Industrial Internet annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Cloud computing segment revenue RMB 6,026.79 hundred million in 2025, up 88.70% YoY, gross margin 5.73% (up 0.74 points). Cloud-service-provider AI server revenue grew more than 3x YoY, with GPU and ASIC solution products both growing fast; the company says order scale and product value rose together and AI-related business became a much larger share of the segment. It is developing next-generation AI platform products and strengthening in-house development and vertical integration of key liquid-cooling components.
quarterly_data.figure: Cloud revenue RMB 6,026.79 hundred million (+88.70%); gross margin 5.73%; CSP AI server revenue more than 3x

quarterly_data.quarter: Foxconn Industrial Internet annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Communications and mobile network equipment revenue RMB 2,978.51 hundred million in 2025, up 3.46% YoY, gross margin 9.28%. Revenue from 800G-and-above high-speed switches rose 13x YoY in 2025; the portfolio covers Ethernet, InfiniBand and NVLink Switch, and the company says its market share ranks first in the industry. It is advancing CPO / NPO next-generation technologies for higher bandwidth and efficiency.
quarterly_data.figure: Network equipment revenue RMB 2,978.51 hundred million (+3.46%); 800G+ switch revenue up 13x

quarterly_data.quarter: Foxconn Industrial Internet annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (company outlook): the company will focus on AI compute, industrial robots and its global footprint; it will fully advance R&D of next-generation AI compute infrastructure equipment, deepen strategic cooperation with leading cloud service providers including Tier1 CSPs, and broaden a product matrix covering data center, high-speed connectivity and advanced cooling solutions. It says it has already begun forward-looking technology work and joint development for the next-generation AI compute architecture and its supporting hardware.
